description: Refine an existing PRD based on feedback. Provide the PRD ID and feedback, and the AI will update the document while preserving version history.

feedback.description: Feedback describing what needs to change (e.g., "Add more detail to user stories", "The API design should use WebSockets instead of polling")

prd_id.description: ID of the saved PRD to refine

sections_to_update.description: Optional: limit refinement to specific sections

name: prd_refine
